title: August and the Salt
author: Isandro Zhou
blurb: Juniper Sandoval, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
